messages:
Sara_CS: Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp (CFO Marta) wants to fast-track their renewal. Request: shorten to 9-month term (prorated pricing), pay via wire (no CC), and include vendor code 98127 on invoice. I have a 10:30 PT call with Marta. Can legal/finance confirm we can do 9mo + wire and what PO / docs we need.
Luke_CSM: Got it. Any price change or they want same annualized price prorated?
Mike_Sales: Marta says same price pro-rated. She also asked if we can accept a PO as initial binding doc and have her team wire same day.
Chantal_Finance: Finance can accept wire but we need a signed PO or MSA amendment with authorized signer + completed W-9. Vendor code must match accounting system. If they only send an email 'intent' we cannot release bank details.
Jess_Ops: I can prep a custom invoice template. Do we send an MSA amendment or SOW addendum to capture 9mo term?
Leo_Legal: We prefer an MSA amendment referencing the original MSA. I've uploaded a draft amendment that includes a prorate table and refund language.
Sara_CS: Perfect. @leo_legal — can you confirm whether we can accept a PO that references our MSA in lieu of DocuSign signature?
Leo_Legal: We need a signed instrument. A PO with an authorized signature referencing our MSA is acceptable. Plain email confirmation from buyer is not sufficient.
Mike_Sales: Understood. I'll push a DocuSign packet with the amendment and add a note: 'sign & wire'. If they send a signed PO instead, we can accept that.
Luke_CSM: Marta said procurement can issue the PO within 48h but wants funds wired same day as PO receipt. Can we gate activation on funds clearing?
Jess_Ops: Yes — activation will be gated on cleared funds. I'll prepare the invoice and include a note to remit with vendor code 98127. Draft invoice snippet:
```
Invoice: AcmeCorp (vendor 98127)
Term: 9 months
Amount: $67,500 (prorated)
PO: <enter PO number>
Remit: secure link will be provided after signature/PO
```
Chantal_Finance: When sending, include currency USD, net30, and vendor code. We'll supply bank instructions via secure portal after we have signed agreement or signed PO.
Sara_CS: Ok team — plan: Leo uploads amendment -> Mike sends DocuSign -> Jess prepares invoice -> Chantal provides secure remit link after signature/PO. I'll update Marta and ask for PO or sign today. Meeting in 20m.
Luke_CSM: :thumbsup:
Jess_Ops: I'll have the DocuSign packet + invoice draft ready in ~2h and post the link here.
Leo_Legal: Amendment draft: https://redwood.docs/amendments/4440001122 — please review before sending.
Sara_CS: Thanks everyone — looping legal/finance + sales. I'll update thread after the call.
